label: Bible Study
prompt: A new _____ I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verse: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
note: Given at the Last Supper — 'new' because of the measure: as I have loved you.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the _____ is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.
verse: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.
note: David's pre-fight speech to Goliath: no sword needed when the battle belongs to someone bigger than the giant.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth _____. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
verse: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
note: Samson's riddle came from a lion's carcass full of bees — impossible to guess unless you'd been there.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For now we see through a glass, _____; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
verse: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
note: Corinth was famous for its bronze, mirrors included — Paul says our clearest view now is still a blurry reflection.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and _____.
verse: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
note: Work it out with fear and 'trembling' — and the very next verse says it is God who works in you.
